blocks.title: About us
blocks.body:
Test Jewellery is a jewellery in Rewari since 2015. We offer gold & silver jewellery, bridal & wedding sets, custom design, old gold exchange. We give every customer our full time and tell the price before we start.

Hallmarked gold, always, Weight and rate shown clearly, Old gold exchanged fairly — that is how we work. How it goes: Tell us what you want → See the rate and weight → Made or ready → Collect with bill. Message us on WhatsApp and we reply quickly — for Rewari and nearby.
